name: Static.app
line: Upload and host static website files with managed HTTPS.

free.text: 7-day trial, no card; 1 website, 50 MB storage

cells.regions: US hosting; Cloudflare delivery; no selectable region

work.math: $6 a month for Starter. 1 site and 100 MB fit the 2-site, 500 MB limits. Builds (100 minutes) are local. Traffic is listed as unlimited. Business-use terms conflict with pricing, so this is conditional. Tax extra.
Static.app does not host an arbitrary application runtime.
Needs external application and PostgreSQL/backup hosting.
